name: Member-safe baseline reads and staged-cut backup diagnostics
summary: Changes reads project before/after states through the existing member policy and neutral author names; non-editors read baseline receipts without account or operation handles. New cuts isolate damaged unrelated receipts only with readable matching names; readable matching project/account/operation identity still refuses cross-name replay before validation, and current-pointer validation stays strict. Pending-cut backup reports, status and host setup-status name the project, stage and original-owner exact HTTP retry. Multiline Reasons are quoted in new exports while existing frozen bytes and receipt hashes remain readable and recoverable.
